Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Summary

Covenir is a BPO partner to insurance carriers — and increasingly, a technology company that happens to serve them. The Platform is how that shows up day to day: modules spanning Print, Call Center, Virtual Mailroom, and Premium & Lockbox, built with an AI-assisted, 80/20 development model where AI handles the first draft and people handle the judgment. The Data Analyst owns the data and reporting that support Covenir’s business — building and maintaining the analytics that give Operations, Sales & Marketing, and leadership a single, trustworthy view of performance, while scouting the AI tools and partnerships that inform Covenir’s build-versus-partner decisions. The Platform is this role’s current top priority, but scope extends to Covenir’s broader data and reporting needs as priorities shift.

Job Description

How Covenir’s Values Show Up in This Role


Committed to WOW our Customers: The dashboards and numbers you produce are what leadership uses to make real calls — you make sure they’re right, not just plausible.
Great Just Isn’t Good Enough: You don’t stop at a working report. You ask if the metric is actually the right one, and if there’s a cleaner way to show it.
One Team, One Goal: Operations, Sales & Marketing, and IT/R&D all come to you with different questions — you treat all of them as your team, not just IT.
Passion for Excellence: Your analysis is clean enough that someone unfamiliar with the data could follow your logic without a walkthrough.


What You’ll Do


Write SQL for data extraction, transformation, and reporting across Covenir’s systems
Build and maintain executive-facing analytics and KPI dashboards — volumes, postage, and SLA performance by customer and business unit
Use Azure data services (Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Blob Storage) supporting the platform’s data warehouse
Research and evaluate AI tools, vendors, and partnership opportunities (for example, document-intelligence platforms) to inform build-versus-partner recommendations
Translate operational and business questions from Operations, Sales & Marketing, and leadership into data requests and reporting
Apply AI-assisted analysis and workflow tools, consistent with Covenir’s 80/20 model
Support data retention, security, and SOC compliance requirements as they apply to platform data


Requirements


2+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or business intelligence, with proficient SQL skills
Working knowledge of Azure data services (Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Blob Storage) or equivalent cloud data tools; AWS experience a plus
Fundamental knowledge of insurance BPO business processes across Print, Call Center, Virtual Mailroom, and Premium & Lockbox
Working knowledge of data collection across multiple business functions, and of data retention and access-control policies
Basic understanding of the AI/API sandbox and its available data workflows
Experience building executive-facing dashboards or KPI reporting
Comfortable researching and evaluating vendors, tools, or partnership opportunities
Ability to create clear, concise data analysis and reporting documentation for stakeholders across Operations, Sales & Marketing, and IT & R&D
Completes data security and confidentiality training, SOC compliance training, and cross-functional onboarding across Platform modules
Bachelor’s degree in a related field (Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business), or equivalent experience
Performs other duties as assigned by the R&D Manager in support of Covenir’s broader business needs


What An A Player Looks Like


Numbers you can defend. A players can explain exactly how a metric was calculated and why it’s the right one, not just hand over a dashboard.
Translates business questions into data. When Sales & Marketing or Operations asks a vague question, A players know how to turn it into the right query.
Curious about AI tooling. A players actively track what’s out there, not just when asked to evaluate a specific vendor.
Comfortable being the single source of truth. When numbers conflict across teams, A players are the ones who resolve which version is right.
Documents the logic, not just the output. A players leave behind reporting anyone can pick up, not a black box only they understand.


Is This Role For You?

Strong fit


Proficient in SQL and comfortable owning data
extraction, transformation, and reporting end to end
Enjoys translating vague business questions into
concrete data requests
Genuinely curious about AI tools and vendor
landscapes, not just the data itself
Comfortable being the tie-breaker when numbers
across teams don’t match


Skip this role if


You want a narrowly scoped reporting role with no ambiguity
You’re not interested in researching AI tools or vendors
You’d rather avoid being the one who resolves conflicting numbers
You need requests to come from a single, consistent source


Worker Type

Regular

Number Of Openings Available

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Crown Linen Service, Inc is looking to add an ON-SITE Data Analyst to the team in Brockton, MA!

Join Crown Linen Service Inc as a Full-Time Data Analyst and immerse yourself in an environment where innovation meets excellence. Located in Brockton, MA, this onsite role offers the opportunity to tackle real-world problems and drive strategic initiatives. With a competitive pay range of $80,000 - $90,000, you will be rewarded for your analytical skills and contributions to our forward-thinking team. Experience the thrill of collaborating with passionate professionals dedicated to high performance and integrity in everything they do.

THIS IS NOT A REMOTE POSITION AND REQUIRES DAILY ON-SITE REPORTING TO OUR BROCKTON, MA LOCATION.

You will be provided with great benefits such as Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Life Insurance, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account, Competitive Salary, and Paid Time Off. Don’t miss the chance to shape the future of our services while advancing your career in a supportive and dynamic workplace.

Make a difference as a Data Analyst

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join our data team. We are a small team at a well-established company, giving us the opportunity to make a real and immediate impact. This role focuses on developing reports and automated dashboards to support multiple departments.

What We Offer


A nimble work environment that provides the freedom to explore our data landscape and discover new strategies
An executive team that values the insights that data can provide
A direct impact on the business via reporting, as well as data-driven strategies
A company culture that supports its workforce and is focused on operating an ethical and sustainable business.


What You Bring


Three to five (3-5) years of working experience with progressively more responsibility and advanced work product.
A curious mind - you will often be tasked with vague targets, and it is up to you how to get there.
A collaborative spirit - we touch every aspect of the business and need to be able to work seamlessly across all business functions.
A heightened business acumen - we are not just data folks. We regularly interact with all levels of the organization and must be able to relate our findings to executable business strategies.
A technically savvy approach.
Be an Excel wizard - much like an instrument, you should be able to play Excel like a fiddle
A comfortable working knowledge of how to query data sets across multiple sources with significant exposure to at least one SQL language, including Joins, CTEs, Aggregations and/or Windows Functions (our bread and butter)
The ability to transform vague business requests into concrete data driven solutions
Work experience with at least one BI tool such as PowerBI, Tableau, etc.
The ability to design, implement and maintain an ever-changing ETL landscape

As a new Data Analyst at Crown Linen Service Inc, you can expect a dynamic work environment where each day brings new challenges. Your schedule will be Monday to Friday, with standard business hours dedicated to analyzing data, identifying trends, and providing actionable insights to enhance our services. You will collaborate closely with various departments, facilitating cross-functional meetings to ensure alignment on projects and initiatives. Expect to create and maintain detailed reports, supporting strategic decision-making processes. Your role will involve problem-solving and innovation, requiring you to think critically and propose solutions that drive efficiency.

Additionally, you will participate in ongoing training and development opportunities, allowing you to continuously enhance your skills and knowledge in a high-performance culture.

Make your move

If you're ready to take your Data analyst skills to the next level and join a team that values hard work and your business analyst expertise, apply today!

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.

Salary: $80000.00 - $90000.00 per year

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Vencora Business Unit

VBU - Covenir

Job Summary

Covenir is a BPO partner to insurance carriers — and increasingly, a technology company that happens to serve them. The Platform is how that shows up day to day: modules spanning Print, Call Center, Virtual Mailroom, and Premium & Lockbox, built with an AI-assisted, 80/20 development model where AI handles the first draft and people handle the judgment. The Data Analyst owns the data and reporting that support Covenir’s business — building and maintaining the analytics that give Operations, Sales & Marketing, and leadership a single, trustworthy view of performance, while scouting the AI tools and partnerships that inform Covenir’s build-versus-partner decisions. The Platform is this role’s current top priority, but scope extends to Covenir’s broader data and reporting needs as priorities shift.

Job Description

How Covenir’s Values Show Up in This Role


Committed to WOW our Customers: The dashboards and numbers you produce are what leadership uses to make real calls — you make sure they’re right, not just plausible.
Great Just Isn’t Good Enough: You don’t stop at a working report. You ask if the metric is actually the right one, and if there’s a cleaner way to show it.
One Team, One Goal: Operations, Sales & Marketing, and IT/R&D all come to you with different questions — you treat all of them as your team, not just IT.
Passion for Excellence: Your analysis is clean enough that someone unfamiliar with the data could follow your logic without a walkthrough.


What You’ll Do


Write SQL for data extraction, transformation, and reporting across Covenir’s systems
Build and maintain executive-facing analytics and KPI dashboards — volumes, postage, and SLA performance by customer and business unit
Use Azure data services (Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Blob Storage) supporting the platform’s data warehouse
Research and evaluate AI tools, vendors, and partnership opportunities (for example, document-intelligence platforms) to inform build-versus-partner recommendations
Translate operational and business questions from Operations, Sales & Marketing, and leadership into data requests and reporting
Apply AI-assisted analysis and workflow tools, consistent with Covenir’s 80/20 model
Support data retention, security, and SOC compliance requirements as they apply to platform data


Requirements


2+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or business intelligence, with proficient SQL skills
Working knowledge of Azure data services (Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Blob Storage) or equivalent cloud data tools; AWS experience a plus
Fundamental knowledge of insurance BPO business processes across Print, Call Center, Virtual Mailroom, and Premium & Lockbox
Working knowledge of data collection across multiple business functions, and of data retention and access-control policies
Basic understanding of the AI/API sandbox and its available data workflows
Experience building executive-facing dashboards or KPI reporting
Comfortable researching and evaluating vendors, tools, or partnership opportunities
Ability to create clear, concise data analysis and reporting documentation for stakeholders across Operations, Sales & Marketing, and IT & R&D
Completes data security and confidentiality training, SOC compliance training, and cross-functional onboarding across Platform modules
Bachelor’s degree in a related field (Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business), or equivalent experience
Performs other duties as assigned by the R&D Manager in support of Covenir’s broader business needs


What An A Player Looks Like


Numbers you can defend. A players can explain exactly how a metric was calculated and why it’s the right one, not just hand over a dashboard.
Translates business questions into data. When Sales & Marketing or Operations asks a vague question, A players know how to turn it into the right query.
Curious about AI tooling. A players actively track what’s out there, not just when asked to evaluate a specific vendor.
Comfortable being the single source of truth. When numbers conflict across teams, A players are the ones who resolve which version is right.
Documents the logic, not just the output. A players leave behind reporting anyone can pick up, not a black box only they understand.


Is This Role For You?

Strong fit


Proficient in SQL and comfortable owning data
extraction, transformation, and reporting end to end
Enjoys translating vague business questions into
concrete data requests
Genuinely curious about AI tools and vendor
landscapes, not just the data itself
Comfortable being the tie-breaker when numbers
across teams don’t match


Skip this role if


You want a narrowly scoped reporting role with no ambiguity
You’re not interested in researching AI tools or vendors
You’d rather avoid being the one who resolves conflicting numbers
You need requests to come from a single, consistent source

Regular

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
About Purple Carrot

Founded in 2014, Purple Carrot delivers clean, long-lasting energy through the power of plants. As the only company in America devoted entirely to plant-based eating, we have spent over a decade perfecting the balance of protein and fiber that only plants can provide. Offering chef-crafted, dietitian-designed meals delivered right to your door, we make plant-forward eating effortless, flexible, and endlessly exciting. Our menu spans quick weeknight dishes, occasion-worthy dinners, breakfast, lunch, snacks, and ready-to-eat meals.

Purple Carrot prioritizes taste and flexibility, offering no membership fees, the freedom to skip or unskip weekly deliveries whenever you want, and a no-pressure, cancel-anytime policy. We pride ourselves on doing plants better than anyone else - and we have the receipts to prove it.

Description

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our mission-driven team. As an integral part of the Data team, you will join forces with the Senior Analytics Engineer in our continued effort to inspire people to eat more plants.

This position will play an important role in building and maintaining resilient, scalable data pipelines and company-wide data infrastructure that empowers Purple Carrot employees to better understand, manage, curate, and analyze the data most relevant to their work.

As the Analytics Engineer, you will be focused on maintaining and improving our data pipelines, supporting data systems and analytics, and helping develop rigorous data products within our modern data stack. This role will synthesize feedback from teams across the business and help translate data needs into reliable, well-documented solutions that allow us to move faster and gain better insights into how our business performs.

We greatly thank all applicants; however, only those under serious consideration will be contacted.

Location


This hybrid role is based in Dedham, MA
Our hybrid approach includes 3 days in-office each week, giving teams the best of both flexibility and collaboration. Many team members choose to come in more often - it's a great way to stay inspired and engaged with the team



On the Plate


Lead and contribute to the implementation and maintenance of end-to-end data pipelines and infrastructure, from ingestion through transformation and analytics
Develop, test, and optimize data models and data warehouse architecture with a focus on performance, scalability, and reliability
Ensure data quality through validation, monitoring, testing, and strong documentation practices
Implement and uphold data governance standards, including data dictionaries, lineage, access controls, and clear ownership of business logic
Build and maintain BI dashboards and reporting tools that help teams understand performance and make data-informed decisions
Support occasional ad hoc and exploratory data analysis to help answer business questions and identify trends
Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for data models, pipelines, reporting logic, and key data definitions
Collaborate closely with the Senior Analytics Engineer and cross-functional partners to execute on defined workstreams within an established data framework
Assist with ad-hoc projects and tasks as necessary



Main Ingredients for the Role


2-3 years of experience in the data space as a senior data analyst, data analyst, analytics engineer, data engineer, or equivalent role
Bachelor's degree in data analytics, computer science, information systems, business analytics, mathematics, statistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience
Able to commute to the Dedham, MA office 3 days per week
Proficiency in SQL and dbt for data transformation, automation, and modeling
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines using modern data stack technologies such as Git, dbt, Stitch, cloud data warehouses, or similar tools
Strong background in data quality assurance, governance frameworks, and best practices for documentation
Experience with BI and reporting tools such as Looker, Omni, or similar platforms
Ability to work independently on assigned workstreams while collaborating closely with a senior team member
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment



Extra Special Sauce


Experience working in or supporting a B2C subscription business model
Comfortable working within an established data framework while driving execution independently on defined workstreams
Strong curiosity and ability to translate business questions into clear, scalable data solutions
Excitement for working in a dynamic environment where data helps teams make faster, smarter decisions
You enjoy documentation, process improvement, and building systems that make work easier for others



Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $90,000 - $100,00. Compensation is based on experience and qualifications, and the posted range is not a guarantee of any specific offer.

Garnish

We love our staff, and show it with benefits (including but not limited to medical, dental, vision, FSA, and life insurance), matching retirement plan, generous and flexible paid time off, Purple Carrot box delivery credits, professional development, and the opportunity to work in collaboration with teammates who are passionate about food!

Final Touches

We are committed to a safe and inclusive work environment, free of discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetics, national origin, ancestry, age, medical condition, mental or physical disability, handicap, veteran status, or marital status.

The Master Data Analyst coordinates and performs day to day tasks for the creation, maintenance, and data quality throughout the lifecycle of a material for all Routes to Market, Business Units, and Bottlers. Improves and streamlines business processes within functional area. Participates in and/or leads projects internally to include material testing and supporting business design requirements, if applicable.

Annual bonus based on performance and eligibility

Proficient in Microsoft Outlook (using advanced functions in MS Excel such as pivot tables, V look ups and some base knowledge of MS Access).
Excellent attention to detail, accuracy, advanced analytical skills, quality, and strong organizational skills

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, both quantitative and qualitative

Description:
Who We AreButcherBox is a certified B Corp headquartered in Boston, and honored to be celebrating our fourth year in a row on Inc.'s list of Best Workplaces. At ButcherBox, we believe in better. That’s why we deliver 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef, free-range organic chicken, pork raised crate-free, and wild-caught seafood directly to our members’ doors. All of our products are humanely raised or wild-caught and never given antibiotics or added hormones ever. We’re working to build a world that’s better for all, and we’re inviting everyone to come along. For us, better means treating our planet with respect. It means improving the lives of animals and the livelihoods of farmers. It means never cutting corners when it comes to doing business. Ultimately, it means better meals, enjoyed together. Our team is made up of people who collaborate and support one another. We’re always looking for outstanding people to join our mission! 

About the Role

Department: Commercial Operations

Reports To: Associate Director of Commercial & Marketing Analytics

Location: Watertown, MA - in office 3 days/week 

Level: Individual Contributor, mid-level

Base Salary: $103,000 - $120,000

 

About the Role

ButcherBox is looking for a Growth Analyst to own new member acquisition analytics. This isn't a build-dashboards-and-hand-off-findings role. You'll identify opportunities, design tests, drive analysis, and follow it through to a decision. The expectation is that you're the connective tissue between data and action; not just telling us what the numbers say, but making sure something happens because of it. 

Our marketing and commercial teams embrace a hybrid model that provides personal flexibility as well as in-person collaboration. The ideal candidate will find value in coming to our Watertown office two to three days per week. You’ll be embedded in the growth team, owning critical metrics alongside them and supporting weekly channel deep dives. 

Responsibilities

Own analysis across paid (social, SEM, affiliate) and non-digital channels (TV, radio, podcast, OOH), plus site funnel and lead/email flow — from surfacing what's happening to advising what to do next 
Design, analyze, and report on A/B and incrementality tests with a bias toward action and iteration 
Build and maintain self-service reporting tools and data resources that enable self-service analytics by the growth team 
Lead the development of our next phase of media attribution, including MTA and media mix  
Build a deep understanding of the new member journey (predictive LTV, LTV:CPA, funnel conversion) and use it to sharpen acquisition strategy 
Translate analytical findings into decisions in partnership with the growth marketing team 
Drive work from question to answer to outcome, including identifying and resolving whatever's in the way 

Qualifications

Excellent SQL skills; proficiency in Power BI or other visualization tools 
Experience in paid media analytics and growth marketing measurement 
Deep knowledge of incrementality testing, multi-touch attribution, media mix modeling, and other measurement tools 
Strong sense of “so what?”, driving action through analysis 
Comfort working in a fast paced environment where decisions cannot wait to be made 
Ability to translate technical analysis into clear, specific recommendations, communicated clearly and concisely to non-technical stakeholders 
Track record of driving projects to closure in cross-functional environments, including navigating ambiguity and multiple priorities, with a bias towards speed

Position Summary

Cambrian College’s Planning, Institutional Research, and Quality department has an immediate requirement for a Data and Quality Assurance Analyst on a full-time basis.

Note: Internal candidates, as defined by the Full-Time Support Staff Collective Agreement, will be given first consideration

Duties and Responsibilities

Duties

The Data and Quality Assurance Analyst advances institutional planning, quality, and excellence by ensuring the accuracy, integrity, analysis, and reporting of data that informs strategic decision making and performance measurement. Working closely with the Manager, Quality Assurance the Data and Quality Assurance Analyst’s duties include:


Supporting institutional reporting requirements related to Ministry accountability, performance metrics, audits, program reviews, and quality assurance processes.
Providing quality assurance support for academic processes (e.g., course outlines, program standards, program plans, program development, program review).
Supporting the Manager, Chair, and Dean in the preparation of institutional reports for senior leadership, the Board, the Ministry, and external parties.
Developing, maintaining, and enhancing dashboards, scorecards, and reporting tools using platforms such as Microsoft Power BI to support institutional planning, performance monitoring, and decision-making.
Automating and streamlining reporting processes to improve efficiency, reduce manual workload, and minimize duplication across departments.
Collecting, validating, analyzing, and reporting institutional data to support quality assurance, accountability, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Collaborating with academic and service departments to identify reporting needs, performance indicators, and institutional data requirements.
Translating complex institutional data into clear, meaningful, and actionable insights for teams, leadership, and decision-makers.
Supporting the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of policies, procedures, standards, and related documentation to ensure institutional compliance and promote best practices.
Preparing documentation, including process maps, workflows, visualizations, and flow charts to support quality assurance processes and promote understanding across the institution.


Qualifications

Required:


Must have a Post-Graduate Degree (e.g., Masters Degree or 4-year Bachelors Degree + professional certifications, or equivalent) in Data Analytics or statistics, Business Analytics, Research Methods, Quality Management, or a related discipline. (A copy of educational documents must be submitted with the application *** education completed outside of Canada, applicants are required to submit a WES or ICAS with their application).
Minimum of three years’ experience in data analysis, quality improvement, process management, project management, or equivalent.
Experience in developing dashboards and reporting tools.
Strong attention to detail in producing work with a high level of accuracy.
Excellent time management and project management skills.
Self-directed and resourceful with demonstrated problem-solving skills.
Excellent interpersonal skills with a high level of professionalism, discretion, diplomacy, and tact.
Strong organizational skills, with the ability to initiate, prioritize, track multiple projects, and meet deadlines.


Additional Assets/Preferred:


Data visualization (Power BI), advanced Excel, and experience with other reporting tools
Knowledge of the college system, key issues and trends of the sector, college operations, and academic processes is considered an asset

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role (the role may be filled at more than one level; strong candidates earlier in their careers will also be considered)
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

Title: Equis Analyst
Description:
Position Overview

Roux is seeking a Database Analyst with hands-on experience using EarthSoft’s EQuIS to support the management of environmental and chemical data for analysis and reporting. The ideal candidate is an experienced analyst with a desire to grow who can execute day-to-day EDD processing and project support while also supporting EQuIS database administration, configuration, and client-facing dashboard/reporting capabilities. This role will work closely with Roux’s existing environmental data management team as we expand Roux’s EQuIS-based service offerings. Candidate is expected to work from the Burlington, Massachusetts office three days per week at minimum.

Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree or higher in relevant technical field.
Minimum of 4 years of environmental data management experience, including practical use of EarthSoft’s EQuIS in a consulting or regulated environment.
Demonstrated experience processing and QA/QC’ing laboratory EDDs efficiently using EQuIS (EDP) (or comparable EDD workflow).
Working knowledge of EQuIS configuration/administration concepts.
Strong skills and proficiency with Microsoft-based software, including MS Access and MS Excel.
Interest and aptitude for building client-facing outputs (dashboards/reporting) using EQuIS dashboards.
Basic to intermediate SQL skills for querying, troubleshooting, and supporting reports/dashboards.
Strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to manage multiple project priorities and tight schedules.
Strong written and verbal communication skills for coordination with project managers, laboratories, and technical staff.
Ability to help build and scale Roux’s EQuIS capabilities by training and supporting other staff, including analysts with prior database experience.


Essential Duties


Support environmental project teams by managing, processing, and quality‑checking environmental data in EQuIS to ensure datasets are accurate, complete, and suitable for reporting, compliance, and analysis.
Collaborate closely with project managers, scientists, engineers, and GIS staff to understand project requirements, prioritize data tasks, and deliver high‑quality data support under tight timelines.
Process laboratory and field EDDs in EQuIS (EDP), perform QA/QC and completeness checks, resolve common errors efficiently, and coordinate corrections with labs and project staff.
Support routine data tracking, data loading, and data delivery workflows.
Develop, run, and refine standard queries (SQL-based or within EQuIS) and reports to support project reporting needs.
Assist with EQuIS database administration and configuration activities, including management of reference values, formats, templates, and standard reports.
Develop client‑facing dashboards and reporting solutions (e.g., EQuIS-based and/or Power BI), working with project teams to translate technical data into clear, usable outputs for clients.
Help document workflows, QA/QC procedures, and guidance materials that improve efficiency, consistency, and quality across Roux’s EQuIS‑based data management services.
Provide hands‑on training and ongoing support to other staff in the use of EQuIS and related data management workflows, enabling consistent and effective use of the system across projects.


Base Salary Range: $75,000 - $95,000. This salary range is based on what Roux in good faith believes it might pay at the time of posting for this position and for this geographic location. Whatever your title, whatever your role — it always comes back to this: we’re a farmer-owned co-op where everyone rolls up their sleeves to get the job done. Three maverick farmers started it all — and we’ve been making our own way ever since.

The Data Visualization Analyst role is designed to help the commercial teams extract, summarize and visualize relevant past performance metrics to drive future performance. It requires a creative thinker who has the ability to transform ideas into actionable tolls that help teams deliver their objectives. This role will:


Work across multiple business teams learning how they operate, understanding insights they need to make decisions
Analyze information from multiple data sources, external and internal to identify business drivers that affect growth and efficiency
Design reports, tools and tracking mechanisms
Translate ideas into tangible output


A Day in the Life...


Delivering insights using compelling Power BI or SAC visualization techniques for business team.
Ability to translate business needs into actionable reporting and visualization thru rapid prototyping and storytelling.
Building models and designing experiments that seek to uncover insights that drive performance.
Analyzing complex data made of unstructured, semi-structured and structured datasets to drive insights.
Active participant in designing creative new ways to use data to help commercial team drive growth.
Work in an environment with internal IT, business teams and external vendors to design and scale work-flows, templates and dashboards .


What We Are Looking For


BA/BS in computer science or related field or equivalent relevant experience, preferably with a focus on data visualization
Minimum 5 years of related experience
Extensive experience with Data Visualization using tools like PowerBI (preferred) and Tableau
Demonstrate ability to work effectively with others within a complex, cross-functional and fast paced organization
Excellent communication. Ability to present ideas and insights to business stakeholders
CPG industry knowledge


Education

Bachelor's or University Degree (Required)

Work Experience

At least 3 Years of Experience

Annual Salary

$87,400 - $120,230

Certain positions may be eligible for short-term and long-term incentive rewards. We also offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits program that supports all aspects of your health and well-being.

Benefits


Complete insurance package on Day-1 that includes a plethora of health and wellness programs
Health, Dental, and Vision insurance
Health savings account

Life and accident insurance
Employee assistance program
Telehealth services
1:1 health coaching
Supportive benefits for all the stages of your life
401(k) with up to 6% Company matching; additional potential discretionary match at year-end
Short-Term Incentive/Performance bonuses
Flexible scheduling options
Vacation pay, up to three weeks of time (pro-rated for your first year of employment)
Holiday pay for 12 holidays
Career development and growth opportunities
Tuition/Education assistance programs
Access to LinkedIn Learning

Parental leave
Bright Horizons Family Solutions – Back-up care, tutoring, etc.
Adoption assistance
Bereavement leave
Up to $300 fitness reimbursement
Up to $300 massage reimbursement
Employee appreciation events
Employee discounts
Charitable giving

You might have our iconic cranberry juice in your fridge or have gotten into heated holiday debate about what’s better - canned or fresh cranberry sauce. Title: Data Analytics Analyst (On-Site)
Description:
Job Details

Description

SUMMARY:

Under the general supervision of the Manager of Financial Systems and Analytics, transforms raw clinical, operational, and financial data into actionable business intelligence. This role builds, deploys, and maintains data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting systems within our outpatient imaging network. You will collaborate with IT teams, radiologists, and clinical staff to optimize operational efficiency, tracking key metrics like machine utilization, referral patterns, and patient wait times.

Priniciple Duties And Responsibilities


Consistently apply the corporate values of respect, honesty, fairness and constant pursuit of excellence in improving the health status for the people of the region through the provision of customer-friendly, geographically accessible and high-value services within the environment of a diagnostic imaging company.
Ensure compliance with HIPAA, data security standards across all reporting platforms, and federal and state regulations. Consistently apply these regulations to day to day analysis and summary of findings.
Design and maintain interactive dashboards to track key performance indicators.
Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from sources like Electronic Health Records (EHR), Radiology Information Systems (RIS), and Picture Archiving and Communication Systems (PACS).
Build automated reports analyzing machine utilization, imaging volume trends, denial rates, and patient turnaround times.
Prepare analysis on various clinical programs as requested. Gather business requirements from clinical directors and executives to deliver customized analytical solutions.
Validate data integrity and conduct root-cause analysis on data discrepancies.
Recommend updates to the computer system accordingly.
Perform special projects as assigned in an accurate and timely manner.
Acts as a resource to staff.
Maintain a professional manner at all times.
Participate in meetings on an as requested basis.
Perform other duties as assigned.


Experience


At least three years of data analysis, business intelligence, or data engineering experience, preferably in healthcare.


Basic Knowlege/Skills


Proficient in Excel and Word with Access database skills.
Advanced skills in writing, debugging, and optimizing complex SQL queries.
Strong proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, or similar data visualization platforms.
Familiarity with healthcare data standards, workflows, and medical terminology (e.g., HL7, DICOM, CPT/ICD-10 codes).
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are essential. Must be able to handle and prioritize workload and work independently.
High level of precision when working with sensitive clinical and financial data.


Education


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Healthcare Informatics, or a related field.


Physical Demands

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. This description is not intended to be a complete statement of the position, but rather to act as a guide to the general work to be performed. The requirements are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The individual's competencies and customer requirements impact the actual role performed. Walks and stands intermittently throughout the day. Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

Join an award-winning organization! With numerous private, state-of-the-art medical diagnostic imaging facilities, join the team that has been providing Rhode Island with imaging excellence for over 80 years! The American College of Radiology has named RIMI one of the first outpatient diagnostic imaging Centers of Excellence in the country and the first in Rhode Island. RIMI also has the honor of being named an eight-time winner of Providence Business News' Healthiest Employers of Rhode Island Award, most recently in 2025!

RIMI offers best-in-class benefits to eligible employees including multi-tiered health plans, flexible spending accounts, generous paid time off, 401(k) plan with profit sharing component, uniform reimbursement, company "swag," yearly reimbursement for continuing medical education, educational assistance (reimbursement) program, student loan repayment program, and career development opportunities. Enjoy competitive pay and all in our innovative culture that consistently provides the highest levels of quality, safety, technology, and patient care.

Title: Product Analyst
Description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring Product Analysts to embed across the product organization and serve as strategic analytics partners to teams across Healthcare, Algorithms, AI, Hardware, and other product areas. In this role, you will help define how WHOOP measures product success, uncover insights that shape roadmap decisions, and translate complex data into clear recommendations that improve the member experience. You will bring strong analytical rigor, product intuition, and intellectual curiosity to help teams make faster, smarter, and more impactful decisions with data.

Responsibilities


Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Design, and cross-functional leadership to inform strategy and roadmap decisions with data.
Own the analytical narrative for your product area, illustrated by defining KPIs, refining measurement frameworks, and surfacing insights that drive action.
Support experimentation and feature launches end-to-end: from defining success metrics to post-launch analysis and iteration.
Build scalable, self-serve reporting & tooling that lets your stakeholders make decisions without waiting on you.
Develop deep context on your product domain and use it to ask sharper questions, challenge assumptions, and push the product forward.
Proactively surface insights and recommendations that go beyond the ask; identify opportunities others haven't seen yet.
Collaborate with a high-performance analytics team in a fast-paced environment where intellectual curiosity is the baseline expectation.


Qualifications


You've done this before: 2-6+ years in an analytical role where you owned business-critical metrics or initiatives. (We're hiring across levels; we'll figure out the right fit together.)
You use AI tools proactively and hold AI-assisted work to the same bar as your own.
You can take a vague question, wrangle the right data, isolate insights, and communicate actionable recommendations to stakeholders who aren't data people.
You're a strong storyteller: you know how to make a compelling, concise case for action.
You're technically sharp: advanced SQL is table stakes. Familiarity with modern data stacks (Snowflake, dbt, ELT workflows) and visualization tools (Hex, Sigma, Amplitude, Looker) is a plus.
You have product sense: you think about the member experience, not just the numbers.
You're curious about how things work. Algorithms, hardware, health science: you don't need to be an expert, but you should want to understand.
You're a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and doesn't wait to be told what to work on.
TEAMS WE'RE HIRING FOR


We’re Looking For Multiple Analysts To Work Across Our Product Teams. During The Interview Process, We'll Work With You To Find The Right Team Fit Based On Your Interests And Strengths


AI Product: The future of intelligent coaching and personalized insights powered by AI/ML.
Algorithms: Where the science meets the product; sleep, recovery, strain, and how algorithmic outputs translate into member value.
Hardware Product: The physical device experience; sensors, wearability, and next-gen hardware.
Healthcare Product: Building WHOOP's Health Operating System; health outcomes, clinical features, personalized wellness.


This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $100,000 - $155,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

Title: Business Intelligence Developer
Description:
Role Purpose

Your job is to turn data into decisions. Hollingsworth & Vose is a global specialty manufacturer with mill operations across the Americas, Europe, and Asia — and the people running those operations, from the mill floor to senior management, need numbers they can trust and analytics they can act on. You build those.




A dashboard is not the outcome. The outcome is a plant manager who catches a margin problem a month earlier, or a finance team that stops arguing about whose number is right. We measure this role by results that matter to the business, not by reports shipped. Trust is the product — you treat it that way.




This is also a role for someone who wants to build with AI, not just read about it. We are embedding AI into how IT delivers — natural-language access to data, automated insights, AI-assisted development — and this role sits at the center of that work.




What You Own

Analytics people rely on. Power BI dashboards and reports covering trend, variance, cost, and margin analysis — with drill-through, drill-down, parameters, and dynamic filtering that let people answer their own next question.
Semantic models that hold up. Accurate models, measures, and KPIs. Multi-site, multi-currency, imperial/metric — handled correctly, to our site and item naming conventions, every time. If two reports disagree, that’s your problem to run down.
The data behind the numbers. Strong SQL against Oracle EBS and our MES database to source, validate, and shape data. You verify before you publish — and when a number is wrong, “the source data was bad” is where your job starts, not where it ends.
The sales cube. Develop against our central SSAS multidimensional cube (live connection / MDX) for cross-ERP, multi-currency sales and margin analysis.
The existing SSRS estate. Maintain and rationalize current SSRS reports while the future state takes shape.
AI in production. Build AI features into Power BI and our internal applications — natural-language Q&A, automated insights, anomaly detection, AI-assisted workflows — and use AI tools daily in your own development.
The relationship. You listen first. You partner with stakeholders to understand the goal behind the question, and you deliver recommendations, not just charts. Nobody who depends on your work waits in the dark for a status update.
Trust in the numbers. Data accuracy, documentation, and version control. Done means running in production, validated against source, documented, and handed off.




The Environment You’ll Work In

We’re honest about this: it’s a real manufacturing systems landscape, not a greenfield. The craft here is turning a complex environment into analytics people trust — if that sounds like work worth doing, you’ll like it here.

Oracle E-Business Suite — OPM process and discrete manufacturing (recipes, batches, inventory, standard costing), AP/AR/GL, and order management, with significant in-house customization.
A manufacturing execution system (MES) — sales orders, machine utilization, mill cost, raw-material consumption, quality metrics, and production scheduling.
A central SSAS multidimensional sales cube aggregating data across ERP systems, with multi-currency and standard-vs-actual cost and margin analysis.
Reporting today is largely SSRS and Power BI; AI tooling is expanding rapidly.




Required

3–5 years building analytical Power BI reports and dashboards — DAX, semantic modeling, performance tuning, row-level security.
Strong SQL with hands-on experience querying Oracle databases.
Experience consuming SSAS multidimensional cubes from Power BI, including MDX — not tabular/DAX only.
SSRS report development or maintenance experience.
Hands-on use of AI tools in your development work (tool-agnostic), and a genuine interest in building AI features into reports and applications.
An analytical mindset — you interpret data, spot trends, and frame insight for decision-making.
A strong communicator who partners well with non-technical stakeholders and works as part of a team.
Comfortable working on-site at a manufacturing mill.




Preferred

Oracle E-Business Suite experience, especially OPM process manufacturing.
MES experience (Tieto TIPS a plus).
Manufacturing or process-industry domain knowledge — costing, recipes, production and quality data.
Master data management (MDM) exposure — working with item, customer, or site master data across multiple systems, or contributing to data governance and standardization efforts.
Power Query / dataflows, paginated reports, or Microsoft Fabric experience.

Title: BI Developer II
Description:
Job Description

We are currently hiring a BI Developer II in Boston, MA.

The BI Developer II role drives business insights at BBC by delivering dashboards, reports, and semantic models on the Power BI platform. This role combines business intelligence development with a consultative approach, partnering with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver scalable analytics solutions aligned to business objectives. Within the Power BI Center of Excellence (COE), the role promotes best practices and supports self-service analytics through documentation, coaching, and user enablement. It also contributes to data preparation and modeling to ensure data quality and performance, while supporting enterprise BI platforms by maintaining reliability, troubleshooting issues, and responding to user needs.

What You'll Brew:


Partner with stakeholders to define analytics requirements and deliver dashboards, semantic models, and data analytics products aligned to business objectives
Support data modeling and transformation activities to ensure data quality, performance, and well-structured semantic models
Promote best practices and provide coaching, documentation, and training to support adoption of self-service analytics through the Power BI COE
Support enterprise BI platforms by troubleshooting data, reporting, and platform issues, and contributing to performance improvements
Ensure analytics solutions follow governance and security standards, including adherence to enterprise policies and access controls
Provide responsive user support, identify opportunities to improve processes and automate workflows, and serve as backup for IT Data & Analytics team members as needed


What Ingredients You'll Bring:


2+ years of professional experience within the Data & Analytics space
1+ years of Power BI experience, including semantic modeling and visualization
1+ year of experience with SQL and data transformation workflows
Experience in a customer-facing role working with end users on requirements, coaching, and training


Desired Experience:


Experience support enterprise solutions for Corporate & Sales functional areas
Experience with programming languages such as Python


Additional Skills:


Strong understanding of semantic data modeling, DAX, and BI best practices, with experience working in Power BI and structured data environments

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Purple Carrot

Founded in 2014, Purple Carrot delivers clean, long-lasting energy through the power of plants. As the only company in America devoted entirely to plant-based eating, we have spent over a decade perfecting the balance of protein and fiber that only plants can provide. Offering chef-crafted, dietitian-designed meals delivered right to your door, we make plant-forward eating effortless, flexible, and endlessly exciting. Our menu spans quick weeknight dishes, occasion-worthy dinners, breakfast, lunch, snacks, and ready-to-eat meals.

Purple Carrot prioritizes taste and flexibility, offering no membership fees, the freedom to skip or unskip weekly deliveries whenever you want, and a no-pressure, cancel-anytime policy. We pride ourselves on doing plants better than anyone else - and we have the receipts to prove it.

Description

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our mission-driven team. As an integral part of the Data department, you will join forces with the Sr. Manager, Data and Analytics (to whom you will also report) in our continued effort to inspire people to eat more plants!

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about transforming and analyzing complex datasets into clear, actionable, and timely insights that drive strategic decision-making and improve business results.

As the Senior Data Analyst, you will be focused on leveraging SQL, Python, and BI tools to identify opportunities, optimize key metrics, and measure performance across the organization. This is a high-visibility role that partners directly and frequently with senior leadership, translating data into high-quality analysis to support the decisions the business acts on. You'll also work closely with marketing and other teams across the organization to help them become proficient in the data assets you produce. You'll be part of a small data analytics team, so your work is visible, and your voice matters.

If you are a detail-oriented problem-solver who thrives at the intersection of data, analysis, and strategy, we'd like to meet you.

We greatly thank all applicants; however, only those under serious consideration will be contacted.


Location


This role is based in Dedham, MA, 3 days per week in the office
Our hybrid approach includes 3 in-office days each week, giving teams the best of both flexibility and collaboration. Many team members choose to come in more often - it's a great way to stay inspired and engaged with the team



On the Plate


Query and analyze large datasets to extract and communicate meaningful insights
Build and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using SQL, Python, and BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Omni, Sigma)
Build and apply machine learning models in Python — from predictive modeling (e.g., cancel/churn prediction, demand forecasting) to applied techniques (e.g., clustering, regression) that generate deeper analytical insight
Train and support teams on the data assets you build, so they have what they need to self-serve
Own forecasting and experimentation initiatives end-to-end, from framework design through measurement and recommendation
Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand what they actually need and provide data-driven solutions
Produce clear reports, visualizations, and presentations for leadership, with the ability to influence decisions without formal authority
Monitor and report on key performance indicators and emerging trends
Assist with ad hoc projects and tasks as necessary



Main Ingredients for the Role


3+ years' experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar analytical role
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Data Science/Analytics) or equivalent experience
Able to commute to the Dedham, MA office 3 days/week
Proficient in SQL for data querying and transformation
Skilled in Python - for advanced analysis and automation, including building and running machine learning models
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Omni, Sigma)
Strong Excel skills for analysis and reporting



Extra Special Sauce


A collaborative team player who thrives on a small analytics team
You love teaching almost as much as you love a clean dataset - nothing makes you happier than watching a teammate go from confused to confident
You've got opinions, and you're not afraid to share them - pushing back when it's the right call, not just going along to get along
You are adaptable to a fast-paced working environment with changing priorities based on the business needs
Genuine curiosity about the "why" behind the numbers, not just the "what."
Experience with dbt or modern data stack tools is a plus



Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $95,000 - $115,000. Compensation is based on experience and qualifications, and the posted range is not a guarantee of any specific offer.

Garnish

We love our staff, and show it with benefits (including but not limited to medical, dental, vision, FSA, and life insurance), matching retirement plan, generous and flexible paid time off, Purple Carrot box delivery credits, professional development, and the opportunity to work in collaboration with teammates who are passionate about food!

Final Touches

Title: Data Analytics & Management - Officer
Description:
About The Job

The Finance Data and AI Office (DART) delivers trusted data, analytics, and AI enabled solutions across Finance, Risk, and Treasury. This role sits within the Automation, Analytics & AI pillar and focuses on building practical, scalable solutions that address real finance challenges end to end—from problem framing and solution design through deployment and adoption—including data governance and internal control capabilities that align to regulatory expectations and standards.

Who We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with business curiosity and judgment and can thoughtfully apply emerging AI capabilities and low‑code/no‑code tools to build data solutions with tangible Finance outcomes—improving insight quality, controls, efficiency, and decision‑making.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Build Agentic AI & Copilot Solutions for Finance


Design and deliver agent‑based workflows that can plan, reason, and execute tasks across finance processes (with appropriate human oversight and controls).
Implement solutions that use LLM copilots for finance narratives, variance explanations, exception triage, and root‑cause analysis
Combine AI reasoning with deterministic logic (rules, thresholds, accounting constraints, materiality) to ensure reliability in controlled environments



Prompt Engineering & Context Design (Finance‑Grade)


Create and refine prompts grounded in finance context (e.g., P&L, cost centers, accounting rules, materiality thresholds) and structure outputs for decision‑making.
Build reusable prompt patterns, evaluation approaches, and guardrails to reduce hallucinations and increase consistency.



Apply Data Science Where It Matters


Use analytics and data science methods (e.g., anomaly detection, classification, forecasting support, explainability) to strengthen finance insight and controls.
Analyze large, complex datasets to identify breaks, drivers, trends, and actionable signals relevant to Finance operations and reporting.



Enable AI Using No‑Code / Low‑Code Platforms


Use no‑code and low‑code tools (e.g., Alteryx, Power BI, Power Platform or similar) to:
Operationalize AI outputs into finance workflows
Orchestrate AI‑driven steps alongside rules‑based logic
Surface AI‑generated insights, exceptions, and narratives to end users



Responsible AI & Controls‑Aware Delivery


Ensure solutions are explainable, auditable, and aligned with governance expectations
Validate AI outputs against financial data and business logic; design monitoring to maintain quality over time.



Regulatory Alignment, Data Governance & Controls


Contribute to BCBS 239 and broader regulatory aligned outcomes by improving traceability, accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and evidencing for critical finance/risk data used in aggregation and reporting
Ensure solutions delivered are consistent with broader regulatory expectations and embed appropriate data governance and controls from design through production



Skills And Experience Needed


Bachelor’s degree in AI, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
3-5 years of experience in emerging AI technologies, data science, analytics, automation (financial services preferred)
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills
Proficiency in SQL and Python
Familiar with data warehousing, data modelling, ETL concepts
Exposure to automation tools (e.g., low‑code platforms, RPA, workflow tools).
Understanding of Finance, Risk and/or Treasury business processes
Strong written and verbal communication skills



Knowledge of the below tools is preferrable


Microsoft Co-pilot Studio
Microsoft 365 Co-pilot
Databricks
Anthropic/Claude
Alteryx
Microsoft Fabric



Salary Range

$65,000 - $113,750 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Title: Timberland: Analyst, Marketing Measurement & Effectiveness
Description:
At Timberland, we’re a force of nature. We’re a team that steps outside, works hard together, and moves the world forward. The brand is widely recognized as the arbiter of boot culture. With a rich heritage of craftsmanship and an eye toward the future, Timberland has a decades-long commitment to make products responsibly, protect the outdoors, and build community.

So, before we get to the job details, take a minute to learn a little more about us – our values and our culture. If you can see yourself working side-by-side with an team of fun, adventure-loving people, Timberland just may be the place for you.

To learn more about our values and our culture, visit Timberland Careers or www.timberland.com.

Timberland: Analyst, Marketing Measurement & Effectiveness

What will you do?

The Analyst, Marketing Measurement & Effectiveness will lead the efforts to measure, optimize, and report on all working marketing investments. Working within the North America Marketing organization, they will regularly collaborate with full marketing organization, the Americas business organization, our global brand partners, and external agencies. This role will be pivotal in setting the objective framework for marketing and helping drive clear, measurable incremental results. Title: Data Platform Analyst
Description:
Company Profile

Founded in 1977, GMO is a global investment manager committed to delivering superior long-term investment performance and advice to our clients. We offer investment strategies and solutions where we believe we are positioned to add the greatest value for our investors. These include multi-asset class, equity, fixed income and alternative offerings.

We manage approximately $80bn for a client base that includes many of the world’s most sophisticated institutions, financial intermediaries, and private clients. Industry-wide, we are well known for our focus on valuation-based investing, willingness to take bold positions when conditions warrant, and candid and academically rigorous thought leadership. Jeremy Grantham, GMO’s Co-Founder and Long-Term Investment Strategist, is renowned as an expert in identifying speculative investment bubbles and also as a leading climate investor and advocate.

GMO is privately owned and employs over 430 people worldwide. We are headquartered in Boston, with additional offices in Europe, Asia and Australia. Our company-wide culture emphasizes commitment to clients, intellectual curiosity, and open debate. We celebrate and respect our differences, while embracing and valuing what each of us brings to work, as we know that diverse teams in an inclusive, caring environment achieve higher engagement and better client results.

Please follow the prompts included in this job posting to apply. The application window for this role is anticipated to remain open until the job is filled, or as otherwise determined by GMO.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Data Platform Analyst to join GMO’s Data Engineering and Operations team within the Technology group. This role offers an opportunity for a seasoned Analyst to leverage their financial reference data and enterprise data platforms experience to evolve GMO’s security master data and portfolio data platforms. Partnering with GMO’s Operations and Investment teams, a successful candidate will translate operational insight into scalable workflow, control, automation, and data quality improvements. They will bring deep experience in Neoxam’s DataHub application and a proven track record leading or supporting security master conversions and data platform migrations.

The position will be based in Boston where GMO is currently operating in a hybrid work model, with the current expectation that this person will be in the office for a minimum of 2 days per week and the balance of the week working either in the office or remotely.

Responsibilities


Develop an expert understanding of GMO’s reference data flow within internal databases and vendor applications: BlackRock Aladdin, NeoXam DataHub, and Eagle PACE
Act as the NeoXam DataHub application subject matter expert: validate portfolio master and other reference data, resolve production issues, and ensure scalable integration with downstream systems
Through hands-on operational execution, identify recurring issues, process gaps, and data quality risks; translate findings into business requirements and recommendations for workflow, control, automation, and data quality improvements
Analyze data in multiple databases and use a combination of vendor toolsets, Python, SQL, and Excel to develop recommendations to improve data quality
Support the design, governance, and transformation activities for portfolio, security master, and reference data across enterprise platforms, including data model review, conversion analysis, controls, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment
Think critically to help automate or improve processes and procedures (e.g. control reports, daily checklist)
Create business requirements for the onboarding of new datasets and collaborate with software developers to test and implement data processing/storage
Explore artificial intelligence tools to enhance existing reference data operations, data quality controls, and production monitoring processes
Participate in the team’s evolution from manually maintaining data to maintaining and monitoring data definitions, quality service-level expectations, exception thresholds, and downstream consumption patterns
Partner with data engineering and business stakeholders to modernize static data quality rules, such as null checks, format checks, and cross-field validations, by introducing contextual quality validation that can learn from historical data, market behavior, and cross-dataset relationships


Required Skills


10+ years of relevant investment industry experience, working with reference or research data
Strong expertise in portfolio/security master data structures and lifecycle events
Hands-on experience with NeoXam DataHub (mandatory)
Strong data analysis skills using python and SQL; ability to work with large datasets
Proven experience supporting or leading security master platform conversions/migrations
Working knowledge of Artificial Intelligence tools and a demonstrated interest in applying them to evolving business needs
High energy and positive attitude – candidate should be conscientious, self-directed, and possess a strong work ethic
Flexibility to be on call to log in at night as needed on a rotational basis
Intellectual curiosity about investment data
Attention to detail with a focus on data quality and control
Strong analytical, organizational, project management, and written communication skills.
Familiarity with BlackRock Aladdin
Familiarity with financial market data providers (Bloomberg, LSEG, ICE)


$155,000 - $170,000 a year

This salary range is estimated for this role and actual pay may be different based on a candidate’s qualifications and/or years of experience. In addition, this position is eligible for a discretionary annual bonus award, which award may be determined by individual, team, department and firm performance, and is subject to the terms of GMO’s compensation plan. This position is also benefits eligible. GMO’s comprehensive benefits program includes medical insurance, dental insurance, life insurance, long-term disability coverage, a 401(k)/profit-sharing retirement plan, open paid time off, leaves of absences, dependent care resources, tuition reimbursement, charitable gifts matching, flexible spending accounts, and commuter benefits.

GMO is committed to the recruitment, employment, and promotion of all candidates equally, regardless of an individual's gender, race, color, national origin, ancestry, age, religion, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military or veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability (except where such disability is a bona fide occupational disqualification) or any other classification protected under federal, state or local law.

GMO will not offer visa sponsorship for this opportunity.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
